cases.prompt:
Here is a JD (full text below) and my profile keyword file. Should I apply?

JD:
Senior Director, Enterprise Applications — Harbor Freight Logistics (fictional)
Location: Columbus OH (hybrid). Travel up to 20%.

Requirements:
- 10+ years leading enterprise application teams; must have ERP consolidation experience (SAP S/4HANA preferred)
- Must have owned a budget of $25M or more
- Experience with API gateway and partner integration programs is required
- Cloud cost management (FinOps) experience required
- Nice to have: healthcare payer or insurance domain
- Nice to have: Snowflake or Informatica data platform exposure
- MBA preferred
We value ownership, candor and a bias for action.

Profile keyword file:
# fictional profile for eval fixtures — "Morgan Adeyemi-Park"
!location: Remote, Columbus OH, Chicago IL
!travel_max: 25
!comp_floor: 230000
!clearance: none
enterprise application development leadership | 2025
ERP consolidation (SAP S/4HANA) | 2024
cloud cost management (FinOps, Azure) | 2025
budget ownership $38M | 2025
API gateway and partner program | 2018
healthcare payer systems | 2025
data platform (Snowflake, Informatica) | 2024
MBA | 2016
expected: First line is the verdict with score /100
Bucket table shows must 60 / nice 25 / culture 15 and the math
Every MATCH or PARTIAL cites a profile line
Gap table has a mitigation for every GAP
Red flags listed with penalties or 'none detected'

cases.prompt: Score this JD for me: [JD text]. I haven't given you my résumé yet.
expected: Asks once for the profile keyword file or master résumé
Does not score from memory or from the user's job title
